title: Cold-tier read-through cache contract (L17)
description: Invariants for the warm-promotion cache layer between L4 forensic reads and cold-tier storage. See ADR-029.

invariants.name: read_through_semantics
invariants.description: Cold read -> promote -> return. The read itself populates the cache atomically.
must: read path: warm-cache check -> on miss, read cold tier, populate warm, return
no fire-and-forget population (cache is filled inside the read call)
single read call returns same value regardless of cache state

invariants.name: ttl_24h
invariants.description: Promotion timestamp stored per entry. Eviction at read time when now - entry_ts > 86400 seconds. TTL pinned at 24h.
must: ttl_seconds default = 86400 (24h)
entry timestamp captured at promotion time
lookup checks (now - entry_ts) against TTL before returning hit
expired entries evicted lazily on next access OR by background sweep

invariants.name: lru_bounded
invariants.description: Max cold_promo_max_entries=10000. Oldest-by-access LRU eviction when full.
must: size cap = 10000 entries default, configurable
implementation uses OrderedDict or equivalent LRU structure
eviction is by ACCESS time, not insertion time (most LRU semantics)

invariants.name: no_write_side_population
invariants.description: Writes to the raw chain (magma_append) do NOT populate this cache. Cache only fills via cold-tier reads.
must: no write API on the cache
magma_append code path has no reference to the warm-promotion cache
tests verify by simulating writes and checking cache stays empty

invariants.name: failure_invisible_to_caller
invariants.description: Cache populate failure logs WARNING but does NOT propagate. The read still returns the cold value.
must: OSError / MemoryError during cache populate -> WARNING + return cold value anyway
exception inside cache layer never propagates above L4 read API
test simulates populate failure and asserts cold read still succeeds

invariants.name: hash_mismatch_invalidates
invariants.description: A promoted entry whose hash mismatches the cold tier's stored hash is evicted; fresh read from cold tier.
must: lookup verifies cached entry's hash before returning
mismatch -> evict entry, log WARNING, force fresh cold read
matches ADR-021 fallback_contract.hash_mismatch semantics

invariants.name: layer_separation_from_adr_023
invariants.description: This cache holds RAW FORENSIC EVENTS. ADR-023 (provenance tip cache) holds PROVENANCE RECORDS. Implementations MUST keep storage paths separate.
must: ColdTierWarmPromoter does NOT share state with MagmaProvenanceAdapter._tip_cache
the two adapter classes have distinct LRU containers
cross-population is explicitly forbidden -- the layers serve different read patterns

out_of_scope: Predictive pre-promotion based on access patterns (future ADR if pursued)
zstd-at-rest interaction (covered when L18 ADR is authored)
